meta_title: AKN Plumbing & Heating | Gas Engineer Southampton
meta_description: AKN Plumbing and Heating offer expert gas engineering, boiler installs and heating repairs across Southampton. Gas Safe registered. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Boilers, Heating & Plumbing
hero_subhead: Boiler broken or heating failing? AKN respond fast across Southampton — keeping your home warm and safe.
services_heading: Complete Gas & Heating Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full central heating installations, AKN Plumbing and Heating covers every aspect of your home's gas and plumbing needs.

services.title: Boiler Repairs
services.desc: Fast diagnosis and repair of all boiler makes and models, getting your heating back up and running as quickly as possible. We carry common parts to fix most faults on the first visit.

services.title: Boiler Installations
services.desc: Supply and installation of energy-efficient replacement boilers from leading brands, tailored to your home's size and hot water demands. All installations include full commissioning and Gas Safe certification.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Complete design and installation of new central heating systems for Southampton homes, including radiators, pipework, and programmable controls. We ensure maximum efficiency from day one.

services.title: Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Landlord and homeowner Gas Safe inspections carried out promptly, with certificates issued the same day. Stay legally compliant and keep your tenants or family protected.

services.title: Boiler Servicing
services.desc: Annual boiler servicing to maintain efficiency, extend appliance lifespan, and keep your manufacturer's warranty valid. Regular servicing can also reduce your energy bills significantly.

services.title: Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: From leaking taps and burst pipes to faulty radiators and cylinder replacements, our plumbing repairs cover all common household issues. No job is too small for the AKN team.

about_pullquote: Every home deserves reliable heating and an engineer you can trust.
about_para_1: AKN Plumbing and Heating was founded in Southampton with a simple aim: to provide honest, high-quality gas and plumbing services that local homeowners can rely on. Based in Coxford, we work across Southampton and the surrounding areas, bringing fully Gas Safe registered expertise to every job we take on.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on turning up when we say we will, explaining work clearly before we start, and leaving your home clean and tidy. Our customers come back to us year after year because they know they'll receive straightforward advice, fair pricing, and a job done properly the first time.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About AKN

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service. Our boiler packed in on a cold morning and AKN were with us within a couple of hours. The engineer was professional, explained exactly what the problem was, and had it fixed in no time. Wouldn't use anyone else.
reviews.author: Claire B.

reviews.text: Had a new boiler installed by AKN and the whole process was seamless. They arrived on time, worked tidily, and walked me through everything before they left. Competitive price too. Highly recommend to anyone in Southampton.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Needed a gas safety certificate for my rental property at short notice and AKN sorted it the very same day. Friendly, efficient, and the certificate arrived promptly. Great local company — will definitely be booking them for the annual service.
reviews.author: Priya S.
